_about: Pictures for the deep-time periods and events, keyed period-<id> and event-<id>; each key a list in the order the More shows them, an empty list where the answer is none. A picture with "held" waits on Michael and is not shown (none at present). Captions may hold <i> for names in italics. A picture with "near" sits after the first paragraph of its More containing that word. Written by Claude from claude/Pictures-Deep-01.md (checked 12 Oct 2026, read by Michael 13 Oct) and Pictures-Deep-02.md (checked 13 Oct); edit the batch files and the tool, not this.
